title: Operation Watermelon

concept.story: Milo leads a spy-style heist to grab a giant watermelon from the farm picnic table. Bruno blows their cover, Rocky takes over to 'show the professionals' and knocks the watermelon off the table, and Chiku panics as it rolls away. It cracks open right in front of Ducky, who thanks everyone for the delivery.
concept.hook: Extreme close-up of Milo in sunglasses peeking over a hay bale, whispering the mission name.
concept.comedy_moment: Rocky's cool strut ends with his sunglasses slipping and a gentle bump that sends the watermelon rolling across the yard.
concept.punchline: The watermelon cracks open at Ducky's feet: 'Thanks for the delivery!' Milo slowly lowers his sunglasses in disbelief.
concept.viral_notes: Heist parody that reads instantly, visual twist that works on mute, and a loopable ending (Milo's stare leads back into his opening whisper).

music.brief: Light comedic 'sneaky spy' pizzicato loop for clips 1-2, a quick rise for clip 3, a stop-down beat on the punchline, then a tiny comedic sting under the Milo stare.
music.source_rule: Royalty-free only (YouTube Audio Library, or a track you own). Never commercial songs.

dialogue.speaker: rocky
dialogue.line: Step aside, amateurs. Watch a professional.

edit.transitions: hard cuts only; a 4-frame white flash before scene 4 to sell the crack
edit.zoom_effects: Driven by each scene's 'punch' list: [start, end, zoom] in clip seconds
edit.captions: word-chunked, white bold with black outline, centred in the lower-middle safe area (Shorts UI-safe), the punchline line in yellow
edit.punchline_emphasis: duck the music to silence for 0.5s before 'Thanks for the delivery!'
